How Medical Reports Work

Uploaded reports are associated with your account. You can view previously extracted information, reuse a report for a future risk assessment, or remove a report when it is no longer needed.

Always verify automatically extracted clinical information before generating a prediction.

Research & Data Safety

Medical report information is presented within your authenticated account for project functionality. Automatically extracted values should be reviewed before they are used for machine-learning prediction. This system is intended for academic and research use and does not replace professional medical evaluation.
